headline: Software Engineer
shortBio: Software Engineer with nearly 8 years of experience building enterprise web applications, AI-powered customer experience products, and cloud-native solutions. AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, currently based in Germany and open to Software Engineer opportunities.

children.text: I'm a Software Engineer with nearly 8 years of experience developing enterprise software across customer experience, CRM, and payment domains. Throughout my career, I've focused on building scalable, maintainable applications that solve real business problems while delivering intuitive user experiences.

At NICE, I contributed to products including CXone Agent Workspace, CXone Agent Copilot, and AI prototype platforms using React, TypeScript, Angular, .NET, GraphQL, AWS, and Microsoft Adaptive Cards. Earlier at Opus Consulting Solutions, I worked on enterprise banking and payment gateway applications using React and .NET technologies.

I enjoy building software that is scalable, reliable, and easy to maintain. Currently based in Germany, I'm continuously expanding my cloud and AI expertise, recently earning the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate certification while actively seeking Software Engineer opportunities.
